title: /integrations/librenms
description: Instructions on how to integrate a LibreNMS instance into Home Assistant.
body:
This  allows you to add a [LibreNMS](https://www.librenms.org/) instance to Home Assistant.

## Prerequisites

You need to [obtain an API key (token)](https://docs.librenms.org/API/#tokens) for your LibreNMS instance.

URL:
  description: "The URL of your LibreNMS instance. For example `https://librenms.example.com`."
API key:
  description: "API key of your user account to connect to your LibreNMS instance."
Verify SSL certificate:
  description: "Whether to verify the SSL certificate when SSL encryption is used to connect to your LibreNMS instance."

## Data updates

The integration polls data every 60 seconds.

## Binary sensors

The following binary sensor entities are created.

| Entity | Description | Default enabled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Status** | Shows the status if the device is connected or not | ✅ |

## Sensors

The following  entities are created.

| Entity | Description | Default enabled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Database version** | Shows the version of the database used by the LibreNMS instance | ❌ |
| **NetSNMP version** | Shows the version of the NetSNMP client used by the LibreNMS instance | ❌ |
| **PHP version** | Shows the version of the PHP used by the LibreNMS instance | ❌ |
| **RRDTool version** | Shows the version of the RRDTool used by the LibreNMS instance | ❌ |
| **Python version** | Shows the version of the Python used by the LibreNMS instance | ❌ |
| **Total device count** | Shows the total count of by the LibreNMS instance monitored devices | ✅ |

## Troubleshooting

When reporting an issue, enable [debug logging](/docs/configuration/troubleshooting/#debug-logs-and-diagnostics), restart the integration, and once the issue recurs, disable debug logging again (the debug log download starts automatically). If possible, also download the [diagnostics](/integrations/diagnostics/) data, and include both the debug log and diagnostics data with your issue report.

## Known limitations

There are no known limitations.

## Remove the integration

If you no longer use the API key, you can remove it from your LibreNMS instance.
